text:
Jordan: Quick sync — we need to lock the Cross-Functional roadmap review slot for next Wed (May 14). Product wants an RFC review + design review + a 15m triage window. Who can own the agenda?
Sam: I can take agenda ownership if we split into blocks: 25m roadmap, 20m RFC, 15m design, 15m triage. Will need slide + 3 example prompts from infra for perf numbers.
Nina: I have a conflict Wed morning. Can we do same day but 4pm PT? Otherwise I'm +1 for Sam owning.
Alec: 4pm PT works for infra. Maria, any blockers from UX?
Maria: 4pm PT is fine. I'll prep the design artifacts and a mockup to walk through. Can someone ping eng on the RFC's open comments? @Sam
Sam: Will do. Quick ask — can we add a decision-log line in the agenda so we capture rollouts/fallback policies? Saves a follow-up.
Jordan: Yes please. Add a decision-log section and a separate column for action owners. Also flag any priorities that require Dedicated support.
agenda-bot: Proposed meeting: Wed May 14, 16:00 PT — "Cross-functional roadmap + RFC review". Duration: 75m. RSVP thread created.
Nina: If we go 75m, can we compress roadmap to 20m? Keep RFC deep-dive longer.
Sam: Sure — updated split: 20m roadmap, 30m RFC deep-dive (incl. 10m for perf Qs), 15m design, 10m triage/decisions.
Alec: Can infra bring a short perf table (latency, cost delta, expected throughput) — simple CSV or code block is fine.
Maria: I'll add a slide with the UX tradeoff matrix.
Jordan: Okay we have owners: Sam (agenda + RFC facilitation), Maria (design), Alec (infra perf), Nina (takeaways & decision-log). I'll post the draft agenda by EOD tomorrow. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can make it or reply here with conflicts.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Nina: :thumbsup:
Alec: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jordan: Also FYI — if anyone wants a pre-read, drop notes in the thread or add links to the Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/roadmap/xfunc-may14 (I'll update after agenda draft).
Sam: One more — can we reserve a 1:1 follow-up slot for any model-compatibility blockers post-review? Marking as optional.
Jordan: Good call. Adding a 30m optional follow-up block after the main meeting.
agenda-bot: Agenda draft posted: https://meetings.redwood.ai/1976543210/agenda. Owners: Sam, Maria, Alec, Nina.
Jordan: Great — thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here and I'll reassign.
